description: Submit a product as a draft listing on MakerRadar, owned by the person you act for: its website and, optionally, a name, tagline and description (we fill in the rest from the site). Already listed sites come back as listed instead. Then get_my_listing; prove the person's ownership of the site (start_ownership_check → verify_ownership — a listing launches only once its site is proven) and choose_launch to send it for review. Needs listings:write.

description.description: What it does and who it's for, 40–4000 characters of plain Markdown. Optional.

tagline.description: What it does in one line, 4–90 characters. Optional.

name: submit_listing
title: Submit a listing
